tema: Grand Review — A2 Checkpoint (Past, Comparatives, There is/are, Some/Any, Going to)

cast_dialogue.linea: Heroes, this is your A2 checkpoint. Everything you learned — past, comparisons, quantities and future plans — lives in one story now.
Last weekend was the best weekend of the year! First we walked in the park, then we watched a film.
While we were watching the film, it started to rain. There wasn't any milk at home, so I bought some.
The countryside is quieter than the city, but the city is more exciting. Next month I'm going to visit both!
There were many people at my birthday party. Were you there? Next year I'm going to bake an even bigger cake!

banco_oraciones.oracion: We were at the park yesterday.
She cooked dinner and then watched a film.
The city is more exciting than the countryside.
There is some milk in the fridge.
There weren't any people at the party.
It wasn't raining when we arrived.
Were you at the party last night?
What were you doing when it started to rain?
Are you going to travel next month?
Was the film good? Yes, it was.
Is there any milk? No, there isn't.
Are they going to come? Yes, they are.

banner_diagnostico.opcion_a: While we watched the film, it was starting to rain.
banner_diagnostico.opcion_b: While we were watching the film, it started to rain.

inicio.definicion_pragmatica: A2 checkpoint: choose the right past form (was/were, past simple, past continuous with when/while), compare with -er/more...than and the -est/the most, say what exists with there is/are, count with some/any/much/many, and talk about the future with going to.

filas: It was raining when we left.
The city is bigger than the town.
There is some milk. There aren't any eggs.
I'm going to travel next month.

ejercicios.pregunta: While I ___ in the park, it started to rain.
The countryside is ___ than the city.
There ___ any milk in the fridge.

ejercicios.afirmacion: We use 'some' in affirmative sentences and 'any' in negatives and questions.
'Going to' is used for past actions.

ejercicios.texto: First we ___ (walk) in the park, then we ___ (watch) a film.
This is ___ (good) cake in the world!

ejercicios.respuesta: Are you going to travel next month?

ejercicios.texto_con_error: There wasn't some people at the party.
ejercicios.respuesta: There weren't any people at the party.

ejercicios.oracion_base: The city is exciting. The countryside is relaxing.
ejercicios.respuesta: The city is more exciting than the countryside.

ejercicios.pregunta: Tell me about your last weekend and your plans for the next one. (One past sentence + one 'going to' sentence.)
ejercicios.respuesta: Last weekend I visited my friends. Next weekend I'm going to walk in the park.

guion: Sofía: How was your weekend, Ben?
Ben: It was the best! First we walked in the park, then we watched a film.
Ben: Yes! While we were watching the film, it started to rain heavily.
Sofía: Were there many people in the park?
Ben: No, there weren't any people. It was quieter than the city centre.
Sofía: Nice! And what are you going to do next weekend?
Ben: I'm going to visit the countryside. It's more relaxing than the city.

comprension.pregunta: What is Ben going to do next weekend?

reading.texto: Last Saturday was the best day of the month. First, Ben and Kenji walked in the park. There weren't many people because it was cloudy. While they were walking, it started to rain, so they went home and watched a film. Sofía cooked dinner and Abuela Carmen baked a cake. Next weekend they are going to visit the countryside, which is quieter and more relaxing than the city.

preguntas.afirmacion: There were many people in the park.
It started to rain while they were walking.
They are going to visit the city next weekend.

answer_key: 8. There weren't any people at the party.
9. What are you going to do next weekend?
